title: Branding shows the owner only the dark look, but members with a light phone see a different colour and no background tone
what: The phone picture on Branding and its words promise that members' app uses the picked colour and the dark background tone. The member app follows the phone's own light or dark setting by default. On a light phone it darkens the gym colour into another shade until it is easy to read, drops the background tone completely, and a background tone on its own changes nothing. The owner never sees this shade, and the 'Easy to read?' list only talks about the dark look.
expected: Branding shows the light look too (a light or dark switch on the phone picture), and its words say the background tone is used only on dark phones.
who: owners who pick a colour or background tone, and their members on light phones
how_often: every time, for every member whose phone is in light mode
fix_line: Add a light or dark switch to the Branding phone picture and say the background tone is for dark phones only

title: The 'Saved' date on Branding has no year
what: Next to Save, Branding shows 'Saved' with the day and month the look was last saved, for example '14 Nov'. A look saved more than a year ago reads exactly like one saved this month.
expected: The year is shown when the save was not this year.
how_often: only for looks saved in an earlier year
fix_line: Add the year to the saved date when it is not this year

evidence: data:Crispy Curves gyms row has a logo only, no colour or tone, heading normal (B-truth-panel-brand-shell-a, 25 Nov), so the colour difference cannot show on the test gym today
